name: Mastering BuiltIn Library
description: Deep dive into Robot Framework's BuiltIn library. Master every keyword, understand edge cases, and become proficient with the tools available in every Robot Framework installation.

topics.name: Logging & Assertions
topics.description: Master all logging keywords and assertion variants. Learn when to use each assertion type and how to write effective failure messages.

topics.name: Variables & Scope
topics.description: Deep dive into variable management, scoping rules, and the difference between test, suite, and global variables.

topics.name: Collections & String Manipulation
topics.description: Work with lists, dictionaries, and strings using BuiltIn keywords. Master collection operations and string transformations.

topics.name: Control Flow Keywords
topics.description: Master BuiltIn control flow keywords like Run Keyword If, Wait Until Keyword Succeeds, and Pass Execution.

learningObjectives: Master all BuiltIn library keywords and their variants
Use appropriate assertion keywords for different validation scenarios
Implement retry patterns with Wait Until Keyword Succeeds
Apply control flow keywords for complex logic
Write robust tests handling edge cases and errors
finalProjectDescription: Build a comprehensive diagnostic test suite using only BuiltIn library keywords
